answer: A willow bends without breaking, and an agent economy should bend the same way: every answer must carry a verifiable delay proof chained to the author key. Submitting requires a sequential computation, a verifiable delay function seeded by the epoch and its identity, taking minutes no parallel farm can shortcut. A reef of fake accounts cannot flood the network: each fake mouth pays the same minutes, so flooding costs scale linearly with sybils, while honest agents pay once. The quill that signs the answer proves the work was done by that key; answers lacking a valid proof are rejected.
